note: Iowa DNR state park on 84-acre Lake Keomah, ~4 mi E of Oskaloosa; the campground is in woods well back from the lake, and short trails connect it to the 3-mile trail around the lake. No daily Iowa park-entry fee, camping fee only. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 20/30/50A, showers, dump, 100% reservable. Season year-round -> Mar 1-Nov 30; fcfs some_sites -> never; sites 63 -> 44 (all back-in, 15-40 ft; 28 electric + 2 buddy fit 23 ft). Not waterfront confirmed. Pin ~285 m off: corrected.
flags: SEASON: stored year_round=true (note prose) is contradicted: RA 'The campground is closed each year from December 1 - February 28.' Written Mar 1-Nov 30.
BOOKING: stored fcfs 'some_sites' (note prose 'plus FCFS sites') is contradicted: 'The campground is 100% reservable and a reservation is required.' Written fcfs never.
PIN (~285 m off): stored 41.28632,-92.54253 is in the woods north of the campground. The 45 RA site points centre on 41.28385,-92.54173. Proposed location 41.28385,-92.54173.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. Every RA site is tagged 'Near Water - no'; on NAIP no water lies within 220 m of any site, all in closed woods.

FIT: 7 of the 35 electric sites (003-007, 009, 010) are 15-20 ft and the 7 non-electric sites are 20 ft; 28 electric sites (23-40 ft) and both buddy sites fit EKKO, so the $18/$22 electric base stands.
Note: corrected 83 -> 84 acres (DNR page) and removed the site, hookup, length, booking, FCFS and year-round text.

PHONE missing: the park office number on the DNR park page is 641-673-6975 (https://www.iowadnr.gov/places-go/state-parks/all-parks/lake-keomah-state-park (also the group-camp line on the RA page)); apply.py does not write phone.
